build_ConvFCBBoxScoreHead: build a ConvFCBBoxScoreHead with BoxIoU scoring type and L1 loss for OLN-Box object proposal detection
build_Shared2FCBBoxScoreHead: build a Shared2FCBBoxScoreHead with 2 shared FC layers and 1024 output channels for ROI head
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through ConvFCBBoxScoreHead to get cls_score, bbox_pred, and bbox_score outputs
test_get_targets: test the get_targets method to compute labels, bbox_targets, and bbox_score_targets from sampling results
review_loss_computation: review the loss method to compute cls, bbox, and bbox_score losses with reduction override support
